source.note: Regular menu from the published mess menu sheet supplied by the owner on 8 November 2026. Supersedes the September notice boards for the regular menu; extras are unchanged and still come from the September boards.

timings.source: Owner-supplied mess timings, 2026-09-22; additional to the PDF menu.

rotationRule.note: Month starts at Week 1: dates 1–7, 8–14, 15–21, 22–28; dates 29–31 continue at Week 1. Interpretation of owner instruction, 2026-09-21.

issues.title: Tuesday sambar choice needs confirmation
issues.detail: The source says “Radish or Louki Sambar (Radish)”. Both names are preserved as a choice.

issues.title: Saturday chaat rotates
issues.detail: The extras board lists weekly alternation without assigning a dish to each week. Saturday choices are labelled rotating; check the counter for the dish being served.

issues.title: Extras counter
issues.detail: Extras and prices are transcribed from the supplied board. Applicability to both Mess A and Mess B is awaiting confirmation; check your counter.
